The chunk of rock instantly transforms into a gargoyle and acts on the same initiative count as Ogrémoch. Ogrémoch can't use this action if he has 50 hit points or fewer. The gargoyle obeys Ogrémoch's commands and fights until destroyed.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Princes of the Apocalypse.

name: Ogrillon Ogre

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Attack:  5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Attack:  5, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Monster Manual (2025).

name: Ogruhl

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ogruhl makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from Ogruhl and knocked prone.

actions.name: Sand Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ogruhl exhales abrasive sand in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Candlekeep Mysteries.

name: Oinoloth
source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The oinoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oinoloth makes two Claw attacks, and it uses Spellcasting or Teleport.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupted Healing (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The oinoloth touches one willing creature within 5 feet of it. The target regains all its hit points. In addition, the oinoloth can end one disease on the target or remove one of the following conditions from it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 7 (2d6). This reduction can be removed only by a wish spell or by casting greater restoration on the target three times within the same hour. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The oinoloth teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse.

name: Oinoloth
damageResistances: cold, fire, lightning, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Bringer of Plagues (Recharge 5-6)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the oinoloth blights the area within 30 feet of it. The blight lasts for 24 hours. While blighted, all normal plants in the area wither and die, and the number of hit points restored by a spell to a creature in that area is halved. Furthermore, when a creature moves into the blighted area or starts its turn there, that creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the oinoloth's Bringer of Plagues for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and is poisoned. The poisoned creature can't regain hit points. After every 24 hours that elapse, the poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10). This reduction lasts until the poison ends, and the target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. The poison ends after the creature successfully saves against it three times.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The oinoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The oinoloth's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oinoloth uses its Transfixing Gaze and makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupted Healing (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The oinoloth touches one willing creature within 5 feet of it. The target regains all its hit points. In addition, the oinoloth can end one disease on the target or remove one of the following conditions from it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion, and its hit point maximum is reduced by 7 (2d6). This reduction can be removed only by a wish spell or by casting greater restoration on the target three times within the same hour. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The oinoloth magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Transfixing Gaze
actions.desc: The oinoloth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed until the end of the oinoloth's next turn. While charmed in this way, the target is restrained. If the target's saving throw is successful, the target is immune to the oinoloth's gaze for the next 24 hours.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes.

name: Olara
source: Critical Role: Call of the Netherdeep

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Olara can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Olara has advantage on saving throws to end the charmed condition on herself, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: The scout has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Olara makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Critical Role: Call of the Netherdeep.

name: Old Croaker

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Old Croaker can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: Old Croaker's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Old Croaker can't bite another target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: Old Croaker makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the toad's turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time. If Old Croaker dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Explorer's Guide to Wildemount.

name: Old Troglodyte
source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage

traits.name: Chameleon Skin
traits.desc: The troglodyte has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

traits.name: Stench
traits.desc: Any creature other than a troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature's next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troglodyte makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage.

name: Olhydra
conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Empowered Attacks
traits.desc: Olhydra's slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Olhydra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Olhydra has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.desc: Olhydra can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. She can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Olhydra makes two slam attacks or two water jet attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 19). Olhydra can grapple up to four targets. When Olhydra moves, all creatures she is grappling move with her.

actions.name: Water Jet
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked prone if it fails a DC 19 Strength saving throw.

actions.name: Summon Elementals (1/Day)
actions.desc: Olhydra summons up to three water elemental and loses 30 hit points for each elemental she summons. Summoned elementals have maximum hit points, appear within 100 feet of Olhydra, and disappear if Olhydra is reduced to 0 hit points.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Crush
legendaryActions.desc: One creature that Olhydra is grappling is crushed for 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

legendaryActions.name: Fling (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Olhydra releases one creature she is grappling by flinging the creature up to 60 feet away from her, in a direction of her choice. If the flung creature comes into contact with a solid surface, such as a wall or floor, the creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was flung.

legendaryActions.name: Water to Acid (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Olhydra transforms her watery body into acid. This effect lasts until Olhydra's next turn. Any creature that comes into contact with Olhydra or hits her with a melee attack while standing within 5 feet of her takes 11 (2d10) acid damage. Any creature grappled by Olhydra takes 22 (4d10) acid damage at the start of its turn.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Princes of the Apocalypse.

name: Ollin

traits.name: Divine Eminence
traits.desc: As a bonus action, Ollin can expend a spell slot to cause its melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If the priest expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Journeys through the Radiant Citadel.

name: Omin Dran
skills: Deception +4, Insight +7, Intimidation +4, Medicine +7, Perception +7, Persuasion +4

traits.name: Divine Strike
traits.desc: Once on each of his turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, Omin can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage of the same type dealt by the weapon.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Omin has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Omin makes two attacks with his maul.

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: War God's Blessing (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.desc: When a creature within 30 feet of Omin makes an attack roll, but before learning whether it hits or misses, Omin can grant the creature a +10 bonus to that roll.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Acquisitions Incorporated.

name: One-Eyed Shiver

traits.name: Chilling Mist
traits.desc: While it is alive, the one-eyed shiver projects an aura of cold mist within 10 feet of itself. If the one-eyed shiver deals damage to a creature in this area, the creature also takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye of Frost
actions.desc: The one-eyed shiver casts ray of frost from its missing eye. If it hits, the target is also restrained. A target restrained in this way can end the condition by using an action, succeeding on a DC 13 Strength check.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Princes of the Apocalypse.

name: Oneirovore

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Realize Nightmares (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The oneirovore manipulates the perception of nearby creatures, sending them into a panic. Creatures of the oneirovore's choice that it can see within 60 feet must make a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the charmed condition, their vision distorted such that they view their allies as creatures of pure fear and hatred. While charmed, a creature will use their actions to attack their allies with intent to kill. A charmed creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Warning Cry (1/Day)
actions.desc: The oneirovore lets out an earsplitting shriek, calling for infernal reinforcements. Creatures that are not Fiends that are within 120 feet of the oneirovore must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Any lesser devils within a 1-mile-radius, centered on the oneirovore, are required by contract to come to its aid upon hearing its Warning Cry. Higher ranking devils may investigate if they desire, but the call holds no magical sway over them.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Chains of Asmodeus.

name: Oni

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The oni's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The oni regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oni makes two attacks, either with its claws or its glaive.

actions.name: Claw (Oni Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage in Small or Medium form.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The oni magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid, into a Large giant, or back into its true form. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. The only equipment that is transformed is its glaive, which shrinks so that it can be wielded in humanoid form. If the oni dies, it reverts to its true form, and its glaive reverts to its normal size.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Monster Manual (2014).

name: Oni

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Attack:  7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.desc: Attack:  5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Monster Manual (2025).

name: Ontharr Frume

traits.name: 5etools Note
traits.desc: Ontharr Frume is presented in Hoard of the Dragon Queen and The Rise of Tiamat as a lawful good, human paladin of Torm. The war priest stat block from Volo's Guide to Monsters has been provided here for ease of use.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The priest makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Guided Strike (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
reactions.desc: The priest grants a +10 bonus to an attack roll made by itself or another creature within 30 feet of it. The priest can make this choice after the roll is made but before it hits or misses.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Hoard of the Dragon Queen.

name: Ontharyx
source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Ontharyx has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ontharyx makes two Unarmed Strike or Nightmare Blast attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or have the frightened condition until the start of Ontharyx's next turn.

reactions.name: Defensive Flight
reactions.desc: Immediately after taking damage, Ontharyx flies up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk.

name: Onyx

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Relative Size
traits.desc: Any damage Onyx would take is reduced to 0. She has advantage on ability checks and saving throws.

traits.name: Dealing with Onyx
traits.desc: Onyx cannot be overcome or killed by combat. Any weapon attack against her that hits AC 12 makes contact but deals no lasting damage. However, if the attack would deal 10 or more damage, Onyx has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of her next turn. If Onyx would take 10 or more damage from spells or other effects, it yields the same result. Spells that impose conditions function normally against Onyx, but those conditions end automatically at the end of the cat's next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) slashing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in The Orrery of the Wanderer.

name: Ooze Master
conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.desc: A creature that touches the Ooze Master or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon that hits the Ooze Master corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition that hits the Ooze Master is destroyed after dealing damage. The Ooze Master can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

traits.name: Instinctive Attack
traits.desc: When the Ooze Master casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, it can make one pseudopod attack as a bonus action.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The Ooze Master can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

reactions.name: Instinctive Charm
reactions.desc: If a creature the Ooze Master can see makes an attack roll against it while within 30 feet of it, the Ooze Master can use a reaction to divert the attack if another creature is within the attack's range. The attacker must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker targets the creature that is closest to it, not including itself or the Ooze Master. If multiple creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target. On a successful save, the attacker is immune to this Instinctive Charm for 24 hours. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Tales from the Yawning Portal.

name: Ooze-Folk
conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Transparent
traits.desc: Even when an ooze-folk is in plain sight, it takes a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot an ooze-folk that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the ooze-folk's space while unaware of the ooze-folk is surprised by the ooze-folk.

traits.name: Fragile Bones
traits.desc: For each 5 damage it takes, the ooze-folk's walking speed is reduced by 5 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ooze folk makes one glass longsword attack and one pseudopod attack.

actions.name: Glass Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage. If a 1 is rolled on an attack roll with a glass longsword, it shatters and can no longer be used.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Lost Laboratory of Kwalish.

name: Ophelia

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.desc: If Ophelia moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Turn of Fortune's Wheel.

name: Oracle

traits.name: Blessings of the Gods
traits.desc: While the oracle is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier. In addition, a creature that hits the oracle with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage.

reactions.name: Divine Insight (3/Day)
reactions.desc: When the oracle or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, the oracle can cause the roll to be made with advantage or disadvantage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Mythic Odysseys of Theros.

name: Oracle of Strixhaven

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the Oracle fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Oracle makes two Magic Flare attacks. She can also use Paradoxy, if available.

actions.name: Magic Flare
actions.desc: ms,rs 10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Paradoxy (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Momentary warps in reality appear at three different points the Oracle can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on each point must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) force damage and is pulled up to 15 feet in a straight line toward the center of the sphere. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pulled. A creature caught in the area of multiple warps is affected by only one, which the Oracle chooses.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The Oracle teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet of herself.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Vector Shift
legendaryActions.desc: The Oracle teleports one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 30 feet of herself. An unwilling target must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw to avoid the effect.

legendaryActions.name: Spellcasting (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Oracle uses Spellcasting.

legendaryActions.name: Vortex Jaunt (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The Oracle uses Teleport, and immediately after she disappears, each creature within 30 feet of the space she left must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) force damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Strixhaven: A Curriculum of Chaos.

name: Oracs the Enduring
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 26

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  15 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales acid in a 90-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 67 (15d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tail Attack
legendaryActions.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Explorer's Guide to Wildemount.

name: Orc

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Tomb of Annihilation.

name: Orzhov Giant

traits.name: Focus
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the giant can target a creature it can see within 30 feet of it and make that creature its focus. The target remains the giant's focus for 1 minute, or until either the target or the giant drops to 0 hit points. When the giant makes an attack roll against its focus, it adds a d4 to its attack roll. If the giant attacks a different target while it has a focus, it subtracts a d4 from its attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage. If the Orzhov giant scores a critical hit, it rolls the damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica.

name: Oshundo the Alhoon
source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk
languages: Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 120 ft., Undercommon

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Oshundo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Oshundo makes two Chilling Grasp or Arcane Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Chilling Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack:  8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) cold damage, and Oshundo regains 14 hit points if the target is a creature.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack:  8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6) force damage.

actions.name: Thundering Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Oshundo emits a wave of domineering energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or take 22 (4d8 + 4) thunder damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Negate Spell (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Oshundo targets one creature it can perceive within 60 feet of itself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, the spell fails, but any spell slots or charges aren't wasted.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk.

name: Osvaldo Cassalanter

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Osvaldo's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Osvaldo has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Osvaldo makes two attacks with its chains.

actions.name: Chain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 14) if Osvaldo isn't already grappling a creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Animate Chains (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Up to four chains Osvaldo can see within 60 feet of it magically sprout razor-edged barbs and animate under the devil's control, provided that the chains aren't being worn or carried. Each animated chain is an object with AC 20, 20 hit points, resistance to piercing damage, and immunity to psychic and thunder damage. When Osvaldo uses Multiattack on its turn, it can use each animated chain to make one additional chain attack. An animated chain can grapple one creature of its own but can't make attacks while grappling. An animated chain reverts to its inanimate state if reduced to 0 hit points or if the devil is incapacitated or dies.

reactions.name: Unnerving Mask
reactions.desc: When a creature Osvaldo can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil, the devil can create the illusion that it looks like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies. If the creature can see the devil, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of its turn.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Waterdeep: Dragon Heist.

name: Otherworldly Corrupter

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.desc: Magic and other features can't determine the corrupter's creature type. If a creature tries to read the corrupter's thoughts, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the corrupter fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The corrupter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The corrupter makes three Whispering Blade attacks and can use Debilitating Touch.

actions.name: Whispering Blade
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to speak until the start of the corrupter's next turn.

actions.name: Debilitating Touch
actions.desc: The corrupter's squirming tentacle lashes out at a creature the corrupter can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn, after which the target is immune to this Debilitating Touch for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker the corrupter can see hits the corrupter with an attack, the corrupter halves the attack's damage against it.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Cunning
legendaryActions.desc: The corrupter escapes nonmagical restraints and ends the grappled and restrained conditions on itself, then moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The corrupter makes one Whispering Blade attack.

legendaryActions.name: Amorphous Escape (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The corrupter dissolves into a shifting mass of flesh, tentacles, eyes, claws, and mouths. Up to two creatures the corrupter can see within 20 feet of itself must make a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This transformation lasts until the end of the corrupter's next turn. While transformed, the corrupter has advantage on attack rolls, attack rolls made against it have disadvantage, and it can move through spaces at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in The Book of Many Things.

name: Otherworldly Steed

traits.name: Life Bond
traits.desc: When you regain Hit Points from a level 1+ spell, the steed regains the same number of Hit Points if you're within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Otherworldly Slam
actions.desc: Attack:  Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + summonSpellLevel of Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Player's Handbook (2024).

name: Othokent

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: Othokent can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

traits.name: Skewer
traits.desc: Once per turn, when Othokent makes a melee attack with its trident and hits, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage, and the lizardfolk gains temporary hit points equal to the extra damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Othokent makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws or trident or two melee attacks with its trident.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Ghosts of Saltmarsh.

name: Othovir

traits.name: Roleplaying Information
traits.desc: Othovir is a gifted harness-maker who doesn't talk about his family or where he came from. He cares about his business, his clients, and his good name. Ideal: "Find what you do well, and do it to the best of your ability." Bond: "I won't allow my name to be tarnished." Flaw: "I get angry when others pry into my private life."

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Othovir adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Othovir must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Storm King's Thunder.

name: Ott Steeltoes

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Ott has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.desc: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Waterdeep: Dragon Heist.

name: Otto
source: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage

traits.name: The Colors of Age
traits.desc: A faerie dragon's scales change hue as it ages, moving through all the colors of the rainbow. All faerie dragons have innate spellcasting ability, gaining new spells as they mature. Red—5 years or less Orange—6–10 years Yellow—11–20 years Green—21–30 years Blue—31–40 years Indigo—41–50 years Violet—51 years or more A green or older faerie dragon's CR increases to 2.

traits.name: Superior Invisibility
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the dragon can magically turn invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentration on a spell). Any equipment the dragon wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.desc: Using telepathy, the dragon can magically communicate with any other faerie dragon within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The faerie dragon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 2d6 + 4 piercing damage.

actions.name: Euphoria Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The dragon exhales a puff of euphoria gas at one creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, or for 1 minute, the target can't take reactions and must roll a d6 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior during the turn: 1–4. The target takes no action or bonus action and uses all of its movement to move in a random direction. 5–6. The target doesn't move, and the only thing it can do on its turn is make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage.

name: Otto Belview

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The mongrelfolk's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: Otto can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Otto makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claw or dagger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Curse of Strahd.

name: Otyugh

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.desc: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its tentacles.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The target dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: The otyugh slams creatures grappled by it into each other or a solid surface. Each creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the end of the otyugh's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't stunned.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Monster Manual (2014).

name: Otyugh
languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Attack:  6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. con Saving Throw DC 15. Failure:  The target's Hit Points maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success:  The Poisoned condition ends.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Attack:  6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: con Saving Throw DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure:  16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. Success:  Half damage only.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Monster Manual (2025).

name: Otyugh Mutate
source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk

traits.name: Virulent Breath
traits.desc: Noxious gas from the mutate's digestion of previous meals spews from its mouth. At the start of the mutate's turn, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mutate makes two Bite or Tentacle attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with Chitin Slam.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition. Every 24 hours that elapse, the target must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. On a successful save, the target is no longer poisoned. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0. This reduction to the target's hit point maximum lasts until it no longer has the poisoned condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 15) and the restrained condition until this grapple ends. The mutate has two tentacles that can grapple one target each.

actions.name: Chitin Slam
actions.desc: The mutate targets one creature it is grappling, slamming the creature against its chitinous plating. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and have the stunned condition until the end of the mutate's next turn.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk.

name: Ougalop

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Ougalop can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Otherworldly Perception
traits.desc: Ougalop can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible or on the Ethereal Plane. It can pinpoint such a creature that is moving.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.desc: Ougalop has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, Ougalop has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target is restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in a net, ending the effect on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

reactions.name: Sticky Shield
reactions.desc: When a creature misses Ougalop with a melee weapon attack, the kuo-toa uses its sticky shield to catch the weapon. The attacker must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw, or the weapon becomes stuck to the kuo-toa's shield. If the weapon's wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is grappled while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. A creature can pull the weapon free by taking an action to make a DC 11 Strength check and succeeding.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Out of the Abyss.

name: Oussa

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Oussa can use its action to polymorph into a Medium snake, or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It doesn't change form if it dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Oussa has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Malison Type
traits.desc:
Oussa has one of the following types: • 
• 
•

actions.name: Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.desc: Oussa makes two ranged attacks or two melee attacks, but can constrict only once.

actions.name: Bite (Snake Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Oussa can't constrict another target.

actions.name: Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Tales from the Yawning Portal.

name: Owl

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

traits.desc: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.desc: The ox is considered to be one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

actions.name: Gore

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse.

name: Ox

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the ox moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.desc: The oxen is considered to be a Huge animal for the purposes of determining its carrying capacity.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Oxen

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the oxen moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.desc: The oxen has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Plane Shift: Zendikar.

name: Padraich

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, Padraich can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Princes of the Apocalypse.

name: Pain Devil (Excruciarch)

traits.name: Aura of Torment
traits.desc: Any creature hostile to the excruciarch that starts its turn within 20 feet of the excruciarch takes 10 (4d4) slashing damage, unless the excruciarch is incapacitated.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the excruciarch's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The excruciarch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sadism
traits.desc: The excruciarch gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for each creature it damaged on its previous turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The excruciarch makes two Scourge attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with Storm of Steel (if available).

actions.name: Scourge
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Storm of Steel (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: The excruciarch swings its scourge wildly around itself. All creatures within 15 feet of the excruciarch must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 31 (6d8 + 4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Vulnerable Gaze
reactions.desc: As a reaction to a creature resisting damage dealt by the excruciarch, it turns its gaze on that creature, negating any resistances and immunities that creature has until the start of the excruciarch's next turn.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Chains of Asmodeus.

name: Paloma
languages: Thieves' cant plus any two languages

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.desc: During its first turn, Paloma has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the assassin scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Paloma is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.desc: Paloma deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the assassin that isn't incapacitated and the assassin doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Paloma makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Panopticus Wizard

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: The dwarf has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

actions.name: Dagger

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Waterdeep: Dragon Heist.

name: Panther

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The panther has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

The fire ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. The explosion destroys the phoenix's body and leaves behind an egg-shaped cinder, which weighs 5 pounds. source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the abishai's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abishai makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Frightful Presence or Incite Fanaticism.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) force damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the abishai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of the abishai must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of it for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the abishai's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Incite Fanaticism
actions.desc: The abishai chooses up to four other creatures within 60 feet of it that can see it. Until the start of the abishai's next turn, each of those creatures makes attack rolls with advantage and can't be frightened.

actions.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
actions.desc: The abishai targets one Dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. The Dragon must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. A chromatic dragon makes this save with disadvantage. On a successful save, the target is immune to the abishai's Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failed save, the target is charmed by the abishai for 1 hour. While charmed in this way, the target regards the abishai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. This effect ends if the abishai or its companions deal damage to the target.

speed: 60 ft., fly 120 ft., swim 60 ft., burrow 60 ft.

traits.name: Chromatic Awakening (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
traits.desc: If the greatwyrm would be reduced to 0 hit points, its current hit point total instead resets to 425 hit points, it recharges its Breath Weapon, and it regains any expended uses of Legendary Resistance. Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section for 1 hour. Award a party an additional 105,000 XP (210,000 XP total) for defeating the greatwyrm after its Chromatic Awakening activates.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)

traits.desc: The greatwyrm doesn't require food or drink.

actions.name: Tail

legendaryActions.desc: The greatwyrm creates four spears of magical force. Each spear hits a creature of the greatwyrm's choice it can see within 120 feet of it, dealing 12 (1d8 + 8) force damage to its target, then disappears.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.desc: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be infected with a disease—a minuscule slaad egg. A humanoid host can carry only one slaad egg to term at a time. Over three months, the egg moves to the chest cavity, gestates, and forms a slaad tadpole. In the 24-hour period before giving birth, the host starts to feel unwell, its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. At birth, the tadpole chews its way through vital organs and out of the host's chest in 1 round, killing the host in the process. If the disease is cured before the tadpole's emergence, the unborn slaad is disintegrated.

Failure:  The target is cursed unawares, and a minuscule slaad egg is implanted in it. Removing the curse destroys the egg. Over 2d4 × 10 days, the egg gestates. In the final 24 hours, the cursed target feels unwell; its Speed is halved, and it has Disadvantage on D20 Test. At the end of this time, the egg turns into a Slaad Tadpole, which chews out of the host and kills it.

traits.name: Amphibious

A creature that touches the aboleth or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased. The disease has no effect for 1 minute and can be removed by any magic that cures disease. After 1 minute, the diseased creature's skin becomes translucent and slimy, the creature can't regain hit points unless it is underwater, and the disease can be removed only by heal or another disease-curing spell of 6th level or higher. actions.desc: The wight makes two longsword attacks or two longbow attacks. It can use its Life Drain in place of one longsword attack.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a zombie under the wight's control, unless the humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Tales from the Yawning Portal.

name: Reduced-Threat Wyvern

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The wyvern makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its stinger. While flying, it can use its claws in place of one other attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Tales from the Yawning Portal.

name: Reef Shark

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The shark has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the shark's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The shark can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Reflection
damageResistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, piercing, slashing
conditionImmunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The reflection can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the reflection can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the reflection has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new reflection rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

name: Refraction of Ilvaash
source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk
conditionImmunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
languages: Common, Deep Speech, telepathy 100 miles, Undercommon

traits.name: Creature Sense
traits.desc: The refraction is aware of creatures within 100 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each one's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The refraction can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
traits.desc: If the refraction fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The refraction has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The refraction makes two Dissonant Claw attacks.

actions.name: Dissonant Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature concentration on a spell, its concentration is broken.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Creatures of the refraction's choice within 60 feet of it must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or take 33 (5d10 + 6) psychic damage and have the stunned condition for 1 minute. A stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The refraction teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied place that it can see.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Mindbreaker
legendaryActions.desc: The refraction targets a creature within 120 feet of itself and disrupts its mental processes, causing the target to have disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of the target's next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Projected Claw (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: The refraction makes one Dissonant Claw attack.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk.

name: Regenerating Black Pudding
conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.desc: A creature that touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the pudding corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The pudding regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the pudding takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the pudding's next turn. The pudding dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a pudding that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new puddings if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new pudding has hit points equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding.

source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The chieftain adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the chieftain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The great warrior adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the great warrior must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

traits.name: Magic Resistance

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape DC 18). Until this grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the regisaur can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

damageImmunities: fire, poison, psychic, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the orthoclath is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The orthoclath is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The orthoclath has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.desc: The orthoclath's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.desc: The orthoclath exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Reigar

traits.name: Glory
traits.desc: The reigar's Armor Class includes its Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The reigar can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: The reigar wears a talarith.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The reigar makes two Trident attacks.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 (1d6) force damage if the reigar is wearing its talarith.

actions.name: Chromatic Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack:  10 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (5d8) damage of a type chosen by the reigar from the following list: cold, fire, lightning, or radiant.

actions.name: Summon Duplicate (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Using its talarith, the reigar summons a duplicate of itself. The duplicate obeys the reigar's commands and uses the reigar's statistics, except it is an unaligned Construct that doesn't have a talarith of its own. The duplicate takes its turn immediately after the reigar. It vanishes after 1 hour or when it is reduced to 0 hit points.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Boo's Astral Menagerie.

name: Reindeer
source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the reindeer moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a ram attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone creature. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden.

name: Relentless Impaler
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Bloodheart Stake
traits.desc: The impaler is magically bound to the ceremonial stake and the sacrificed corpse the ritual caster used to create it. If the impaler is reduced to 0 hit points, it disappears, then re-forms 1d8 hours later in the nearest unoccupied space to the stake and regains all its hit points. The impaler dies only if it is reduced to 0 hit points while either the ceremonial stake is removed from the sacrifice's corpse or the impaler is on a different plane of existence from that corpse.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the impaler fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The impaler makes one Spike attack and two Wicked Spear attacks.

actions.name: Spike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:  11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage, and the target's speed is halved until the start of the impaler's next turn.

actions.name: Wicked Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack:  11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spike Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Twisted, spectral spikes shoot out from the impaler's body. Each creature within 30 feet of the impaler must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Speed Spike
legendaryActions.desc: The impaler teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It can then make a Spike attack.

legendaryActions.name: Deepen Wounds (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.desc: Each creature whose speed is currently reduced by the impaler's Spike attack takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

name: Relentless Juggernaut

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The juggernaut regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the juggernaut takes Radiant damage or damage from a Critical Hit, this trait doesn't function on the juggernaut's next turn. The juggernaut dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The juggernaut deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The juggernaut makes two attacks, using Executioner's Blade or Crushing Stone in any combination.

actions.name: Executioner's Blade
actions.desc: Attack:  10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Slashing damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the juggernaut's next turn.

actions.name: Crushing Stone
actions.desc: Attack:  10, range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the juggernaut's next turn.

legendaryHeader: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

legendaryActions.name: Implacable Advance
legendaryActions.desc: The juggernaut moves up to half its Speed, ignoring Difficult Terrain. Each creature in its path is subjected to the following effect. str Saving Throw DC 18. Failure:  7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Regardless of Success or Failure:  The juggernaut can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Sweeping Blade
legendaryActions.desc: dex Saving Throw DC 18, each creature in a 15-foot Cone [Area of Effect]. Failure:  11 (1d10 + 6) Slashing damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the juggernaut.

description: Official D&D 5e monster published in Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.

name: Relentless Juggernaut
languages: understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

traits.name: Regeneration
